# PrismaUI_F4 runtime

Public PrismaUI_F4 2.1.0 uses an in-process Ultralight 1.4.0 runtime. It is a separate
Fallout 4 mod and is not bundled or staged by CommonwealthOnlineUI.

Install PrismaUI_F4 2.1.0 in the Fallout 4 mod list, load it before CommonwealthOnlineUI,
and keep its binaries outside this repository. The supplied consumer header lives at
`CommonwealthOnlineUI/include/PrismaUI_F4_API.h`.
